chat.title: PEPEK Virtual Assistant
chat.subtitle: 24/7 Executive Qualification & Support
chat.welcome: Hello! I am PEPEK GRUPO's Executive Assistant. How may I assist you with your mobility needs in Angola today?

emergency.message: I'm truly sorry about what happened and I understand your concern! 🛡️ Your safety and peace of mind are our absolute priority. Our 24-hour standby and towing centre in Talatona is ready to step in immediately with assistance or a replacement vehicle. I'm transferring you now to our emergency operations team.
emergency.handover: Urgent Assistance / Vehicle on the Road

human.message: With pleasure! 🤝 It's always a pleasure to talk to you. Our executive consultants at the Talatona centre are available 24/7 to assist you directly via WhatsApp or by phone.

change.message: I completely understand the need to adjust your trip! ✨ Our support and operations team handles any rescheduling or cancellation quickly and flexibly. I'll put you through to our centre with your request reference.

wedding.message: What a special and happy occasion! 💍🥂 For unforgettable moments, we offer our impressive VIP Limousine (20 seats, 999,999 Kz/day), as well as the Mercedes-Benz S-Class, Mercedes-AMG G63 and Range Rover Autobiography. We can personalise the service with a gala chauffeur and decoration!

largeEvent.message: We have extensive experience and take pride in coordinating large fleets and convoys for state summits and international events in Angola! 🌟 To size matching vehicles and dedicated chauffeurs, I'll put you in touch with our Key Account Manager.

recommend.message: It will be a great pleasure to help you find the ideal vehicle! 🚗✨ To give you the best recommendation: how many people will be travelling, and will the trip be within Luanda or involve other provinces of Angola?

compare.message: Excellent question! 💎 For executive prestige and ultimate refinement, the Toyota LC 300 and Land Cruiser 250 are unmatched. If the mission requires off-road toughness in the provinces, the Toyota Hilux 4x4 is the benchmark. For groups of up to 15 people, the Mercedes V300 Class and the Hiace van offer complete comfort. And for maximum ballistic security, we offer the B6/B7 Armoured Range Rover Vogue.

specsArmoured.message: Our Armoured Range Rover Vogue is a true luxury fortress! 🛡️ It has certified B6/B7 ballistic armour, 5 fine-leather seats, ballistic glass and a secure communication system. Available with a driver trained in executive protection (1,999,999 Kz/day).

specsVan.message: For delegations and groups needing generous space! 🚐 The Mercedes-Benz V300 Class VIP has 7 high-luxury reclining armchairs, the Toyota Hiace van carries up to 15 passengers and the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter seats up to 21 people with heavy-duty air conditioning and a large luggage area.

specsHilux.message: The Toyota Hilux Double Cab 4x4 is the queen of endurance on Angolan roads! 🚜 It has 5 seats, a reinforced cargo bed, 4x4 drive with low range, an economical diesel engine and tropicalised air conditioning (189,999 Kz/day).

specsSuv.message: The Toyota LC 300 and Land Cruiser 250 offer 7 spacious seats, full-time 4WD, a smooth automatic gearbox, premium leather finishes and independent multi-zone climate control. The height of executive prestige! ✨

availability.message: We have vehicles ready and cleaned at our central base in Talatona! 🚗✨ From economical city cars to high-prestige SUVs and armoured vehicles. What dates and what type of vehicle do you have in mind?

howToBook.message: The process is simple, fast and transparent! ✨ Choose the vehicle from the catalogue, set your dates and submit the request on the website or confirm directly on WhatsApp with our Operations Directorate.

prices.message: Our official 2026 rates are fully transparent and in Kwanzas (Kz)! 💳 Economy city cars from 49,999 Kz (Kia Morning / Celerio), SUVs at 139,999 Kz – 169,999 Kz (Creta / Tucson / Tiggo 7), 4x4 pick-ups at 189,999 Kz (Hilux), executive SUVs at 299,999 Kz – 599,999 Kz (Prado / LC300) and armoured vehicles at 1,999,999 Kz.

payment.message: We make payment easy, safe and convenient! 💳 In Angola we accept Multicaixa, Multicaixa Express and bank transfers (BAI, BFA, Atlântico). From abroad, we accept Visa and Mastercard cards, MB WAY and SWIFT transfers in USD or EUR. The proof of payment is available once payment is confirmed.

invoicing.message: The system records your company's or embassy's invoice in Kwanzas (AOA) or foreign currency (USD/EUR) and provides the proof of payment once payment is confirmed. For accredited corporate clients, we offer 30-day payment terms.

driver.message: We offer the most distinguished Protocol Chauffeur service in Angola (+35,000 Kz/day)! 👔 Our chauffeurs are uniformed, multilingual (Portuguese, English and French) and have advanced training in defensive driving, etiquette and absolute confidentiality.

provinces.message: We move those who move Angola, from Cabinda to Cunene! 🇦🇴 Travel fees from Luanda range from 150,000 Kz to 500,000 Kz (according to the official catalogue table). In the provinces, chauffeur support includes 35,000 Kz/day, fuel 50,000 Kz and accommodation/meals 30,000 Kz/day.

rates.bengo: For Bengo the official fee is 150,000 Kz (Return: 300,000 Kz).
rates.icolo: For Ícolo e Bengo the official fee is 200,000 Kz (Return: 400,000 Kz).
rates.group250: For Huambo, Benguela, Zaire, Malanje, Kwanza Sul/Norte and Uíge the fee is 250,000 Kz (Return: 500,000 Kz).
rates.group350: For Huíla and Lunda-Norte the fee is 350,000 Kz (Return: 700,000 Kz).
rates.bie: For Bié the fee is 400,000 Kz (Return: 800,000 Kz).
rates.group450: For Cunene, Namibe, Cuando Cubango and Lunda-Sul the fee is 450,000 Kz (Return: 900,000 Kz).
rates.moxico: For Moxico / Moxico Leste the fee is 500,000 Kz (Return: 1,000,000 Kz).

deposit.message: The self-drive security deposit is set strictly according to the official 2026 catalogue: 300,000 Kz for light city cars, 500,000 Kz for mini SUVs and 1,500,000 Kz for executive SUVs, 4x4s and luxury vehicles. 💳 The full amount is released when the contract closes after inspection.

penalties.message: Our policy is 100% transparent: a late return of up to 1 hour carries a penalty of 15,000 to 50,000 Kz; no cleaning is 15,000 Kz; not refuelling is 25,000 Kz (light car) or 50,000 Kz (SUV/Van); and unauthorised travel outside the agreed areas is an offence of 500,000 Kz.

location.message: We're strategically located to serve you with excellence! 📍 Headquarters in Talatona (opposite HCTA, Condomínio Ateliê dos Sonhos, Rua Reino do Bailundo), a 24/7 desk at the New AIAAN Airport (Corridor 4 – Lower Floor – Arrivals) and a regional hub in Huambo (Albano Machado Airport).

airport.message: A very warm welcome to Angola! 🛫🇦🇴 We provide executive transfers at 4 de Fevereiro Airport and the New AIAAN International Airport (where we have a 24/7 desk in Arrivals Corridor 4). Our chauffeur waits with a name sign, helps with luggage and there are no fees for flight delays.

insurance.message: Your peace of mind is 100% guaranteed! 🛡️ All vehicles have full insurance cover and 24-hour technical assistance. In the event of any mechanical issue, we immediately send an equivalent or higher-category replacement vehicle.

diplomatic.message: We are honoured to regularly serve embassies, diplomatic missions and international summits in Angola. 🤝 We guarantee absolute discretion, impeccable representation fleets, certified B6/B7 armoured vehicles and protocol-trained chauffeurs.
replies: Talk to a Diplomatic Account Manager

hours.message: Our support and operations centre in Talatona and our desk at AIAAN Airport operate around the clock, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and public holidays! 🕒

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Services
faq.subtitle: Clear answers on booking processes, contract requirements, safety and operations across Angola.

items.q: What are the requirements to rent a vehicle (self-drive)?
items.a: Private and executive self-drive customers must present a valid ID card or passport, a driving licence held for more than 2 years, proof of address or stay in Angola, and a security deposit by card or bank transfer.

items.q: How does the Executive Mobility service with a Chauffeur work?
items.a: Our chauffeur service is all-inclusive: we provide a top-of-the-range vehicle with fuel (or as agreed), driven by a uniformed professional certified in executive protocol, defensive driving and confidentiality. The chauffeur remains at the disposal of the client or delegation throughout the contracted period.

items.q: Can the vehicles travel outside Luanda (interprovincial trips)?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. Our entire 4x4 and SUV fleet is authorised and covered to travel to Huambo, Bengo, Benguela and any other province in the country. Vehicles are fitted with 24/7 GPS tracking and backed by mobile assistance nationwide.

items.q: How does airport meet & greet work (4 de Fevereiro / AIAAN)?
items.a: Our chauffeur waits in the international arrivals hall holding a name sign with the passenger's or institution's name. We track the flight number in real time to adjust the pickup time at no extra cost if the flight is delayed.

items.q: How does invoicing work for embassies, governments and companies?
items.a: The system records invoices and issues proof of payment once settlement is confirmed, in local currency (AOA) or foreign currency (USD/EUR), as stated on the invoice. We offer current-account contracts with 30-day payment terms subject to prior accreditation.

items.q: What happens in the event of a breakdown or incident during the trip?
items.a: PEPEK GRUPO guarantees 24-hour technical assistance and the immediate dispatch of a replacement vehicle of the same or a higher category, at no extra cost to the client, ensuring the continuity of your mission or journey.

blog.resourcesText: Use these shortcuts to turn the blog's information into a mobility decision.
blog.guidesText: Simple answers to the most common questions before booking.
blog.guide1Q: How do I choose the right vehicle?
blog.guide1A: Consider passengers, luggage, route and the level of representation. For delegations, also confirm the chauffeur and protocol support.
blog.guide2Q: Can pickup or drop-off be outside Luanda?
blog.guide2A: Yes. Enter the province, municipality and a landmark in your request. The team confirms availability, logistics and any rate adjustment.
blog.guide3Q: Is there a service for companies?
blog.guide3A: Yes. PEPEK supports corporate mobility, missions, events and delegations with dedicated planning.
